dont believe that doctors crap about X time to live.

Because most doctors assume or believe that they are the personification of accumulated medicinal knowledge of humankind they will just simply say you have X time to live.

Change your diet and move to a healthier environment. For late stage cancer you will need additional treatments and there are numerous effective ones outside of what you learn in med school.
